fusions.name: Snarled Line
fusions.desc: Strings a 5-tile tangle of strands ahead of you for 5 seconds that drags nearby enemies inward. Each one it catches takes a lash that deals 10 damage and is stunned for 1 second.

fusions.name: Garrote
fusions.desc: Whips a cord of strands around an enemy within 5 tiles, dealing 28 damage plus 5% of a boss or elite's maximum health, and leaves it [Suppressed] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Matted Fleece
fusions.desc: Fluffs your coat into a barrier that absorbs the next 22 damage and holds for 8 seconds. Your armour rises by 8% while it holds.

fusions.name: Algae Camouflage
fusions.desc: At night, your dodge chance rises by 12%.
